CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Implementation_Date__c), NULL, (5 * FLOOR( (Implementation_Date__c - Request_Date__c + 1) / 7 )) + MIN( 5, MOD(Implementation_Date__c - Request_Date__c + 1, 7) + MIN(WEEKDAY(Request_Date__c), 6) - MIN(WEEKDAY(Implementation_Date__c), 6) ) )
CustomField.label: Days to Resolve
